description: PromptDocument is `.ai/local/prompts/<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>-<slug>.md`, beside the record of the same stem. It is a projection: it holds nothing the record does not, it is regenerated by `majordomus capture render`, and it is never edited by hand — an edit is lost on the next render, which is why the record and not this file is what the archive guarantees.  The field numbers are the order in the file:  ---                            1  front_matter --- # Prompt — <started_at>        2  heading | | |                          3  summary ## CONTEXT                     4  context      (optional) ## OUTPUT                      5  output       (optional) ## PROMPT                      6  prompt       (always, always last) The rendering as a whole: the front matter over the body.
title: capture

Header.description: The front matter of a rendering: every member of the record except `text`, in the record's own declared order, then `record`. A member the record does not carry is omitted rather than written as null — absent says "not observed", null would claim it was observed to be nothing. The record is what these values came from; this is a projection of it and never the other way round.

finished_at.description: Observable only after the turn the capture hook runs in front of, so absent from a record the UserPromptSubmit hook wrote rather than present and empty.

record.description: The file name of the JSON this was rendered from — a name, never a path, because a rendering can only ever point inside its own directory.

Body.description: The body: a heading, the same fields again as a table a person reads, then the prompt last and always. CONTEXT and OUTPUT are written when the record carries them.

sections.description: Every heading of the body, in document order, as the reader flattens it.
